title: refactor(ci): cleanup release automation, consolidate lint/test workflows, and deps hygiene
author: Daniel Kim
description: Context: the repo has accumulated overlapping GitHub Actions workflows for lint/test/release over multiple historical migrations; variant branching for node versions and per-repo release steps increased CI runtime and maintenance costs. This PR consolidates lint and test workflows into a shared matrix-driven pipeline, tidies up the release automation to reduce duplicated steps across packages, and performs dependency hygiene for actions and a few build-time packages. Motivation: reduce CI runtime and flakiness, make release path deterministic, and keep actions/deps up-to-date to avoid security notices.
commits: c1e4b8f: split legacy ci scripts into tools/ci and standardize environment detection
9bf2a6c: unify test matrix (.github/workflows/test.yml) to node16/node20 with caching and parallelism tuning
d4b8f55: simplify release workflow: extract common steps to scripts/release/prepare_release.sh and gate publish by auth-check
e0c6aa2: bump actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, and use community-verified cache action; update action pinning
f8b1cde: remove deprecated CI scripts and update docs/ci.md
review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Can we keep a short migration guide for teams still referencing legacy workflows?; Author: added docs/ci.md section and a README note with grep commands to find old usages.
Priya Rao: Noted a flakiness pattern for integration tests on node16; Author: tuned parallelism and increased test timeouts, added retry for flaky suite.

Marco Silva: Are the action pins acceptable from a security perspective?; Author: pinned to major stable versions and added digest comments where available; called out remaining actions for follow-up.
CI Bot: integration-tests failed on first run due to cache key mismatch; Author: fixed key generation and re-ran — green on second run.
summary: Consolidate CI workflows, improve caching/parallelism, refresh action pins, and clean release automation to reduce maintenance and CI cost.
